## Type of change

- [ ] **feature** — new functionality or user-facing behavior
- [ ] **fix** — bug correction
- [ ] **chore** — maintenance, tooling, dependency bumps
- [ ] **refactor** — behavior-preserving restructure
- [ ] **test** — tests only

## Which part of the workflow this affects

- [ ] App Shell
- [ ] Builder Canvas
- [ ] Topology Nodes
- [ ] Readiness Screen
- [ ] Dashboard
- [ ] Testing
- [ ] Other

## Self-review checklist

- [ ] TypeScript compiles without errors (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Biome lint passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] No hardcoded UI text in JSX — strings from `APP_STRINGS` only
- [ ] All new components are typed with strict TypeScript
- [ ] Relevant unit or component tests added or updated
- [ ] No `console.log` left in code
- [ ] PR is scoped to one feature only
- [ ] Import paths use `@/` alias throughout
